AGENTS.md.excerpt:
# Checks

- **Gate**: `pnpm check:changed` runs format, lint, typecheck, the tests that import your changes, and the ratchets your paths select, and prints only failures. Run it once when you are done editing (and again after a rebase or fix), then push. A pass is cached, so don't rerun it "to be sure", and don't also run `pnpm tc`, `pnpm lint`, or the full suite. Never `--no-verify`.
- **While iterating**: run only what you touched: `pnpm test <file.test.ts> --maxWorkers=2`, `pnpm tc:node|tc:web|tc:cli`, `pnpm exec oxlint <files>`, `pnpm exec oxfmt --write <files>`. Transitive tests and the full suite are CI's job ([details](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#targeting-local-tests)).
- Run checks in the foreground with `timeout 900`. Don't background them and poll with `sleep`.
- Stacked PRs: `ORCA_CODE_QUALITY_BASE=<ref>` or `--base=<ref>`; `--base=HEAD` covers only uncommitted edits.
- CI: `gh pr checks --watch` or `gh run watch <id> --compact --exit-status` (no polling). Read failures with `gh run view <id> --log-failed`; for long logs, filter with `grep -nE "error|FAIL|✗"` instead of tailing.

# Repo Rules

- Ensure main is always releasable
- Never break the CI. If it's broken, merge fixes.
- **Tests are the exception.** Prove a change by running it (app via CDP screenshot, CLI, script), not by committing a test. Commit one only for logic where a silent regression is costly: parsers/codecs/round-trips, security boundaries (escaping, path traversal, auth, crypto), persistence/migrations/data loss, concurrency or state-machine invariants, cross-platform paths. It must call real code with minimal mocks, hardcode its expectations, and fail if the fix is reverted; prefer one invariant over many examples. Never test UI behavior ("button does X"), wiring/IPC glue, mock calls, copy, constants, or timing. Critical user flows belong in the golden E2E journeys (`tests/e2e/golden-journeys`), not unit tests. Delete low-value tests you touch instead of updating them. Perf contracts: `*.performance.test.*` only ([rules](./docs/agents-md-refs/test-antipatterns.md#perf-contracts)); more in [anti-patterns](./docs/agents-md-refs/test-antipatterns.md).

# Design System

All UI work — layout, color, typography, spacing, component selection, UX behavior — must follow [`docs/STYLEGUIDE.md`](./docs/STYLEGUIDE.md). Use the tokens defined in `src/renderer/src/assets/main.css` (the canonical source) and the shadcn primitives in `src/renderer/src/components/ui/`. Don't invent new color values, font sizes, or shadow tiers when a documented one already covers the role.

# Electron UI Validation

- Always run tests and agent-launched apps in the background with `ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1`.
- Never steal monitor focus or reveal test windows: no `show()`, `showInactive()`, `bringToFront()`, `app.focus()`, or OS activation. Use CDP screenshots of hidden renderers.
- Keep native-focus and visible-window tests paused on the user's desktop; run them on an isolated display or CI.
- Rebuild modified launch-policy code before running an app (stale build wrappers are not safe).
- Use the `$electron` skill and Playwright CDP for rendered Orca UI checks. Do not use computer-use for Orca UI validation.
- Rendered UI E2E checks need an explicit, reproducible viewport and state.
- Screenshot presentational components without Electron: `pnpm fixtures:shot <id>` ([fixtures](docs/agents-md-refs/component-fixtures.md)).

# Code Style

## Reuse Before Reimplementing

Before writing new logic at any scale extend or generalize it instead of building a parallel version.

## Avoid Comments

- Only use when code does not describe
- BE CONCISE. 1 LINE if possible (why not how)

## File and Module Naming

Never use vague names like `helpers`, `utils`, `common`, `misc`, or `shared-stuff` for files, folders, or modules. They carry zero info and tend to become dumping grounds. Name files after what they _actually_ contain — prefer the concrete domain concept (e.g. `tab-group-state.ts`, `terminal-orphan-cleanup.ts`) over the generic role (`tabs-helpers.ts`, `terminal-utils.ts`). If you find yourself reaching for `helpers`, the file probably has more than one responsibility and should be split, or there's a better name hiding in the code that describes what the functions operate on.

# First Class Citizens

Every change must consider these areas:

1. Cross-Platform Support (mac/linux/windows)
   - Guard platform-specific behavior at runtime; use platform-aware shortcuts, paths, and existing process wrappers. Before changing platform-specific code, processes, shells, shortcuts, paths, or native modules, read [`docs/agents-md-refs/cross-platform-support.md`](./docs/agents-md-refs/cross-platform-support.md).
2. Remote hosts
   - Features should work locally and on remote hosts
3. Mobile
4. Folder Workspaces
   - Don't assume every workspace is a git worktree.

# Footguns

## Git / GitHub

If changing code around `git`, `gh`, source-control, or review behavior read [`docs/agents-md-refs/git-workflow.md`](./docs/agents-md-refs/git-workflow.md).

README.md.excerpt:
Orca

中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português · Türkçe · Русский

Bots inside your agent IDE.

Open source. Bring your own everything: your Claude Code or Codex, your local or remote machines, your tools. Ask from Slack or your phone. When it needs you, it's one tab away.

Download Orca  ·  Explore bots →

## Features
### Orca Bots Ask a bot in Slack, Linear, or GitHub to fix a bug, and come back to a tested pull request. It runs on your own Claude Code or Codex. Open its work in Orca to review it or step in. [Overview](https://orca.dev/bots) · [Security](https://orca.dev/docs/bots/security) · [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/bots)
### Chat or Terminal Run any agent in Chat UI or as the raw CLI, and move a conversation between the two without losing context. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/agents/native-chat)
### Orchestrate Agents Hand a big task to one agent. It splits the work, starts worker agents in their own workspaces, and brings their results back to you. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/orchestration)
### Run Anywhere Pair a Remote Orca Server, work on any SSH host, or give a worktree its own cloud VM. Your agents keep running when your laptop sleeps. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/ways-to-run)
### Mobile App Pair Orca with the mobile app to get pinged when an agent needs you, reply in chat, and keep work moving on any of your machines when you are away from your desk. [iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.orca.app) · [Android APK](https://orca.dev/download/android) · [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/mobile)
### Review AI Output Review diffs, leave notes on exact changed lines, and send focused feedback back to an agent. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/annotate-ai-diff)

# Exclude mobile’s independent workspace/lockfile: recursive discovery causes ERR_PNPM_UNUSED_PATCH.
# Explicit Windows addon workspaces avoid file:-dependency relinks, whose virtual-store churn
# raced Windows node-gyp and removed @vscode/windows-process-tree’s binding.gyp mid-rebuild.
packages:
  - native/windows-notifications
  - native/windows-registry
  - native/windows-security
  - src/packages/*

minimumReleaseAge: 4320
shamefullyHoist: true

# Enables pnpm's global virtual store outside CI; under config/ because the repo root only admits
# allowlisted entries.
pnpmfile: config/pnpmfile.cjs

# Orca resolves the user’s Claude CLI via pathToClaudeCodeExecutable; exclude SDK’s ~95 MB/platform
# bundled CLIs so that override stays mandatory.
ignoredOptionalDependencies:
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64'
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-x64'
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-linux-arm64'
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-linux-arm64-musl'
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-linux-x64'
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-linux-x64-musl'
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-win32-arm64'
  - '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-win32-x64'

# Development and test jobs need only their host. Cross-target packaging opts in
# with pnpm install:release (or explicit pnpm install --os / --cpu targets).
supportedArchitectures:
  os:
    - current
  cpu:
    - current

allowBuilds:
  # Its postinstall only hardlinks the platform binary over the JS launcher.
  '@ast-grep/cli': true
  '@parcel/watcher': true
  '@swc/core': false
  '@vscode/windows-process-tree': false
  agent-browser: false
  bun: true
  cpu-features: true
  electron-winstaller: false
  esbuild: true
  # Its install script only rebuilds when no @koromix/koffi-<platform> prebuilt is installed.
  koffi: false
  msw: false
  node-pty: true
  ssh2: false
  '@orca/windows-notifications': false
  '@orca/windows-registry': false
  '@orca/windows-security': false

# Link @types/<peer> beside peer dependents (e.g. React/lucide) for global-virtual-store resolution.
addMissingPeerTypes: true

# Published declarations import undeclared deps; hoisting hid missing types/jest-dom augmentation,
# but the global virtual store requires explicit package dependencies.
packageExtensions:
  '@testing-library/jest-dom':
    dependencies:
      '@types/aria-query': ^5.0.1
    peerDependencies:
      vitest: '*'
    peerDependenciesMeta:
      vitest:
        optional: true
  '@tiptap/extension-list':
    dependencies:
      prosemirror-model: ^1.0.0
  # electron-vite reads electron/package.json and the binary path at build and dev time.
  electron-vite:
    peerDependencies:
      electron: '*'
  electron-updater:
    peerDependencies:
      electron: '*'
    peerDependenciesMeta:
      electron:
        optional: true
  mermaid:
    dependencies:
      '@iconify/types': ^2.0.0
      '@types/d3-selection': ^3.0.0
      type-fest: ^5.0.0
  playwright-core:
    peerDependencies:
      electron: '*'
    peerDependenciesMeta:
      electron:
        optional: true
  remark-parse:
    dependencies:
      vfile: ^6.0.0

overrides:
  dompurify@<3.4.17: 3.4.17
  # Upstream markdown/math packages still require the vulnerable 0.16 line.
  katex@>=0.11.0 <0.18.2: 0.18.10

ci-cache-warmup-platform-jobs.yml.excerpt:
name: Warm shared CI platform cache jobs

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  warm-linux-runtime:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    concurrency:
      group: ci-cache-warmup-linux-runtime-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'schedule' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Separate cache stores per pool; native keys are image-scoped, and ci-cache-warmup.yml warms hosted 24.04 x64.
        runner:
          [
            blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm,
            blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404,
            ubuntu-24.04-arm,
            ubuntu-22.04
          ]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-node-dependencies
        with:
          native-runtime: node
          node-version: '24'
          # Hosted consumers of these images restore neither the Electron archive nor the root store.
          cache-electron-package: ${{ startsWith(matrix.runner, 'blacksmith-') }}
          cache-pnpm-store: ${{ startsWith(matrix.runner, 'blacksmith-') }}
          cache-pnpm-store-lookup-only: 'true'
      - name: Populate shared Electron archive
        if: startsWith(matrix.runner, 'blacksmith-')
        run: node config/scripts/electron-installation/platform-layout/install-electron-package-binary.mjs
      - name: Verify native cache is usable
        run: node config/scripts/native-build/node-addons/ensure-native-runtime.mjs --check-only

  # node-server's hosted macOS lane needs nothing; this serves hosted macOS PR contracts and updater tests.
  warm-macos-runtime:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    concurrency:
      group: ci-cache-warmup-macos-runtime-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-node-dependencies
        with:
          native-runtime: node
          node-version: '24'
          # A main-scoped archive stops each macOS PR from saving its own copy.
          cache-electron-package: 'true'
          cache-pnpm-store: 'false'
      - name: Populate shared Electron archive
        run: node config/scripts/electron-installation/platform-layout/install-electron-package-binary.mjs
      - name: Verify native cache is usable
        run: node config/scripts/native-build/node-addons/ensure-native-runtime.mjs --check-only

  warm-windows:
    concurrency:
      group: ci-cache-warmup-windows-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'schedule' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [windows-2022, windows-11-arm, windows-2025]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-node-dependencies
        with:
          native-runtime: node
          # Windows PR consumers download packages directly; retain only the build caches.
          cache-pnpm-store: 'false'
      - name: Verify native cache is usable
        run: node config/scripts/native-build/node-addons/ensure-native-runtime.mjs --check-only

      - name: Resolve the Windows Rust build scope
        id: rust-scope
        if: runner.arch == 'X64' && matrix.os != 'windows-2025'
        shell: bash
        run: node config/scripts/native-build/windows/windows-rust-build-scope.mjs >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Cache Windows CLI launcher
        if: runner.arch == 'X64' && matrix.os != 'windows-2025'
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            native/windows-cli-launcher/.build
            native/windows-cli-launcher/target
            native/windows-agent-hook/.build
            native/windows-agent-hook/target
            ~/.cargo/registry
          key: windows-cli-launcher-v2-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ steps.rust-scope.outputs.toolchain }}-${{ steps.rust-scope.outputs.ap

ci-cache-warmup.yml.excerpt:
name: Warm shared CI caches

on:
  # Cache-input pushes seed immediately; this schedule repairs eviction and image changes.
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/ci-cache-warmup.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/ci-cache-warmup-platform-jobs.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/ci-cache-warmup-platforms.yml'
      - '.github/actions/install-node-dependencies/**'
      - '.github/actions/restore-pnpm-verification/**'
      - '.github/actions/prepare-native-runtime/**'
      - '.github/actions/prepare-windows-cli-launcher/**'
      - '.github/actions/prepare-headless-compiler/**'
      - 'config/scripts/runtime-verification/headless-detector/headless-detector-compiler-cache.mjs'
      - '.github/actions/prepare-linux-package-fixture/**'
      - '.github/actions/prepare-wayland-clipboard/**'
      - 'native/wayland-clipboard/**'

      - 'config/docker/daemon-shutdown-descendants/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.npmrc'
      - 'config/pnpmfile.cjs'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/node-addons/ensure-native-runtime.mjs'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/windows/initialize-windows-native-toolchain.mjs'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/windows/capture-windows-native-environment.cmd'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/node-addons/rebuild-native-deps.mjs'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/node-addons/node-pty-job-ownership.cjs'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/windows/windows-pe-machine.cjs'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/windows/windows-process-tree-gyp-rebuild.mjs'
      - 'config/scripts/native-build/windows/windows-process-tree-creation-time.cjs'
      - 'config/scripts/electron-installation/platform-layout/install-electron-package-binary.mjs'
      - 'config/scripts/electron-installation/platform-layout/electron-platform-path.mjs'
      - 'config/scripts/zip-extractor-command.mjs'

      - 'config/scripts/electron-installation/shared-dist-cache/shared-electron-dist-cache.mjs'
      - 'config/scripts/artifact-storage/reflink-copy/space-sharing-copy.mjs'
      - 'config/patches/**'
      - 'native/windows-notifications/**'
      - 'native/windows-registry/**'
      - 'native/windows-security/**'
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/ci-cache-warmup.yml'
      - '.github/actions/prepare-headless-compiler/**'
      - 'config/scripts/runtime-verification/headless-detector/headless-detector-compiler-cache.mjs'
      - '.github/actions/prepare-wayland-clipboard/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-cache-warmup-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  warm:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true
    concurrency:
      group: ci-cache-warmup-linux-x64-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'schedule' }}
    # Blacksmith and GitHub-hosted jobs restore from separate cache stores; warm both.
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404, ubuntu-24.04]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Default-branch caches can be restored by every PR; PR caches cannot.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-node-dependencies
        with:
          native-runtime: node
          node-version: '24'
          cache-electron-package: 'true'
          # No hosted job restores the root store, so keep it out of GitHub's cache quota.
          cache-pnpm-store: ${{ startsWith(matrix.runner, 'blacksmith-') }}
          cache-pnpm-store-lookup-only: 'true'

      - uses: ./.github/actions/prepare-headless-compiler
